purpose: Single frontend utility for branded paise values and display formatting.
businessRules: Components must not divide paise by 100 directly.
Backend and frontend contracts must name paise explicitly.
Only safe non-negative integer paise values can be branded as PriceInPaise.
Customer-facing formatted INR values must include the ₹ symbol.
aiHint: Do not add rupee-based inputs here. Convert backend numeric paise to PriceInPaise at API boundaries.
